policy: V13 preserves RestatedPeriodView v1 as presentation-only and adds a reconstructible account.registry/v1 artifact whose inner account_registry_digest is exactly the pre-existing ReportingLedger/FinancialSnapshot digest definition. This provides account-class/consolidation/valuation semantics required by future deterministic historical replay without changing Snapshot v2 bytes.

additions.authority_note: Content-addressed portable chart-of-accounts artifact reconstructing the exact ReportingAccountSpec list whose digest is already bound by ReportingLedger and FinancialSnapshot v2. It contains no balances and grants no ledger mutation or execution authority.
